description: A country's headline economics from the World Bank: GDP, GDP growth, GDP per capita (nominal and PPP), inflation, unemployment, population and growth, government debt, current account, exports, imports, FDI, real interest rate and life expectancy, each with its latest year, the previous year and the change. Plus region, income level and capital. Costs $0.005 USDC on Base via x402.

country.description: ISO code (CA, DEU) or English name (Canada)
